name: naukri_recommended_auto_apply
prompt:
The script output above is a JSON summary from the hourly Naukri recommended-jobs auto-apply run.

Format it for WhatsApp:
- If "applied" has entries: list each as "✅ Applied: <title> @ <company>" with the URL.
- If "needs_review" has entries: list each as "✋ Needs you: <title> @ <company> — <detail>" with the URL (screening questions or unclear confirmation; Vishal must finish these manually).
- If "external" has entries: list each as "🔗 Company-site apply: <title> @ <company>" with the URL.
- End with one line: "Today: <applied_today_before_run + newly applied>/<daily_cap> applies used."
- If the output contains "NAUKRI_NOT_LOGGED_IN": tell Vishal the Naukri session expired and he should run: ~/Development/Aarambh/hermes-agent/.venv/bin/python ~/.hermes/scripts/naukri_login.py
- If it contains "NAUKRI_BLOCKED": say Naukri bot-wall blocked the run; only alert if this is the first block today, otherwise return [SILENT].
- If applied, needs_review, external and failed are ALL empty and there is no error: return [SILENT].
